# Rare Vehicle Workshop Service Vehicle Manuals

This repository contains workshop service manuals, ECU wiring diagrams, tuning guides, ROM files and drivers for Mitsubishi and other vehicles.

## What's here

Workshop manuals (PDF), ECU wiring diagrams, and technical documentation for:

- Mitsubishi Evo 1-3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, X (Lancer Evolution)
- Mitsubishi Colt Ralliart
- Mitsubishi EvoX SST gearbox
- Mitsubishi Lancer (2003, 2004-2005 Sedan, 2006 Wagon, 2010, Sportback 2010)
- Mitsubishi Eclipse (2000-2002, 2010)
- Mitsubishi Galant 2010
- Mitsubishi Outlander 2010
- Mitsubishi Pajero (Sport 1998 Diesel, 2001-2006)
- Mitsubishi Grandis 2006
- Mitsubishi Delica L400 (1995, 1999)
- Mitsubishi Magna / Verada (1995, 2004)
- Mitsubishi Mirage 1994-1998
- Mitsubishi 380 Series (Workshop, Body Repair, 2005)
- Mitsubishi Airtrek (2005, 2006)
- Mitsubishi 1G/2G Lancer/Eclipse (1995)
- Mitsubishi 3000GT FSM 1992-1996 (2 volumes)
- Mitsubishi Wiring Diagrams 1994-2010
- Mitsubishi Transmission manual 1990-2001
- Mitsubishi Owners Manuals 2015
- Subaru STI, Forester 2007, Workshop 2004
- Toyota Camry 1994-2007, Yaris 1999-2003
- Holden Captiva 2006-2017
- Mazda RX-8
- Hyundai Genesis Coupe fuel system
- Hyosung GT125-250, GT650SR

## File structure

- `manuals/` — ZIP archives of workshop manuals, split into ≤80MB parts where needed
- `manuals/mitsubishi/` — Mitsubishi non-Evo models
- `manuals/other/` — Non-Mitsubishi brands
- `wp-content/uploads/simple-file-list/Manuals/` — Individual Evo PDFs (Evo4-5, Evo6, Evo7, Evo8, Evo9, EvoX)
- `wp-content/uploads/2022/01/` — Tuning guides and ECU reflash recovery PDFs
- `wp-content/uploads/2022/02/` — ECU connection wiring diagrams (Evo 1-3 through EvoX)
- `wp-content/uploads/pdf-previews/` — Cover page JPEG previews for each document
- `roms/` — ECU ROM files
- `drivers/` — Device drivers (Tactrix OpenPort, EcuFlash)

## Served via GitHub Pages

`https://evoscan.github.io/evoscan-manuals/`
